messages.cardFaces.CWM035_Mailman.description: Place 2 <WOOD>, 2 <CLAY>, 1 <REED>, and 1 <STONE> on four different revealed action spaces, occupied or not. The next player to use each space may pay you 1 <FOOD> to take its resources. You need not pay yourself.
messages.cardFaces.CWM035_Mailman.name: Mailman
messages.cardFaces.CWM037_MasterStableman.descrip: Immediately before receiving at least 2 animals from an animal accumulation space, you may build up to 2 <STABLE> for 1 <WOOD> each. Animals received through card effects do not count.
messages.cardFaces.CWM037_MasterStableman.name: Master Stableman
messages.cardFaces.CWM038_Minimalist.description: At the end of the game, get 9, 6, 4, or 2 bonus <SCORE> if you have exactly 0, 1, 2, or 3 improvements in front of you, respectively.
messages.cardFaces.CWM038_Minimalist.name: Minimalist
messages.cardFaces.CWM040_Permaculturist.descript: You may sow <GRAIN> on unused farmyard spaces without adjacency to existing <FIELD>. Sown spaces count as used, but are not <FIELD>. You may remove their <GRAIN> at any time and must remove it before scoring. Effects that sow additional <GRAIN> <FIELD> do not apply to these spaces.
messages.cardFaces.CWM040_Permaculturist.name: Permaculturist
messages.cardFaces.CWM041_Politician.description: Immediately get 1 <STONE>. Up to twice per round, at any time, you may exchange 1 <REED> for 1 <STONE> or 1 <STONE> for 1 <REED>.
messages.cardFaces.CWM041_Politician.name: Politician
messages.cardFaces.CWM042_Remodeler.description: Immediately before renovating your wooden house, you may return one built <STABLE> to your supply and build 1 wooden room for free.
messages.cardFaces.CWM042_Remodeler.name: Remodeler
messages.cardFaces.CWM043_ResourceLender.descript: Whenever you receive building resources from an action space, you may add 1 resource of a type received, then distribute all those building resources, in any order, one per remaining round space. At the start of those rounds, you get the corresponding resource.
messages.cardFaces.CWM043_ResourceLender.name: Resource Lender
messages.cardFaces.CWM044_SiloGirl.description: As soon as you live in a stone house, place 1 <GRAIN> on each remaining even-numbered round space and 1 <VEGETABLE> on each remaining odd-numbered round space. At the start of those rounds, you get the crop.
messages.cardFaces.CWM044_SiloGirl.name: Silo Girl
messages.cardFaces.CWM045_StableDeliveryman.descr: Add 3, 5, 7, and 9 to the current round. Place up to one <STABLE> from your supply on each corresponding round space. At the start of those rounds, you may pay 1 <WOOD> to build that <STABLE>, otherwise return it to your supply.
messages.cardFaces.CWM045_StableDeliveryman.name: Stable Deliveryman
messages.cardFaces.CWM046_StoneCurator.descriptio: Whenever you use a <STONE> accumulation space, you also get 1 <FOOD>. At the end of the game, get 1 bonus <SCORE> per 2 stone rooms and per 2 improvements whose printed cost includes <STONE>.
messages.cardFaces.CWM046_StoneCurator.name: Stone Curator
messages.cardFaces.CWM047_StorehouseMinder.descri: When played, you may put 1 to 4 different building resources from your supply on this card. At the start of each harvest, choose up to 2 types already on it and add one of each from the supply. At the start of each round, you may take all resources of one type from this card.
messages.cardFaces.CWM047_StorehouseMinder.name: Storehouse Minder
messages.cardFaces.CWM048_SundayWorker.descriptio: Once during rounds 7 and 14, you may pay 1 <FOOD> to take one of your peoples' actions twice. If you use an accumulation space with that action, you get double the amount of goods and/or <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.CWM048_SundayWorker.name: Sunday Worker
messages.cardFaces.CWM049_SunriseAdmirer.descript: At the start of each of the next 3 rounds, you may pay 2 <FOOD> to plow an unused space in the easternmost farmyard column, opposite your starting rooms. Normal <FIELD> adjacency applies. If you decline, discard this card.
messages.cardFaces.CWM049_SunriseAdmirer.name: Sunrise Admirer
messages.cardFaces.CWM050_TapestryWeaver.descript: At the start of each harvest field phase, if you have at least 3 <SHEEP>, place 1 <FOOD> from the supply on a room without such a <FOOD> marker. Each marker is worth 1 bonus <SCORE> at the end of the game.
messages.cardFaces.CWM050_TapestryWeaver.name: Tapestry Weaver
messages.cardFaces.CWM051_TavernKeeper.descriptio: At the start of each harvest, if you have at least one empty room, you get 1 <GRAIN> and 1 <FOOD>. Each empty room is worth 1 bonus <SCORE> at the end of the game.
messages.cardFaces.CWM051_TavernKeeper.name: Tavern Keeper
messages.cardFaces.CWM052_TileMaker.description: Immediately get 1, 2, 3, or 4 <CLAY> if at least 1, 3, 6, or 9 full rounds remain. At the end of the game, every player tied for the most clay rooms gets 2 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.cardFaces.CWM052_TileMaker.name: Tile Maker
messages.cardFaces.CWM053_VillageFool.description: At the start of each round, you may place one hand card face down under this card; it cannot be used again. At the end of the game, each card under this one scores 1 bonus <SCORE>, except the third, fifth, seventh, and ninth cards.
messages.cardFaces.CWM053_VillageFool.name: Village Fool
messages.cardFaces.CWM054_WheelbarrowPusher.descr: Whenever you receive exactly 1 building resource from an accumulation space, you also get either 1 building resource of your choice or 1 <FOOD>. In games with 4 or more players, get both instead.
messages.cardFaces.CWM054_WheelbarrowPusher.name: Wheelbarrow Pusher
messages.cardFaces.CWM055_WoodWorker.description: After using an action space, you may place 1 <FOOD> from your supply on it to get 1 <WOOD>. The next player to use that space takes the <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.CWM055_WoodWorker.name: Wood Worker
messages.cardFaces.CWM056_Almshouse.description: After each harvest feeding phase, you may discard 1 begging card received in any harvest for failing to feed your family.
messages.cardFaces.CWM056_Almshouse.name: Almshouse
messages.cardFaces.CWM058_AppleTree.description: Put 1 <WOOD> from the supply on an empty farmyard <FIELD>. That <FIELD> counts as sown. During each harvest field phase, you get 1 <FOOD>. The prerequisite requires an actual farmyard <FIELD> tile.
messages.cardFaces.CWM058_AppleTree.name: Apple Tree
messages.cardFaces.CWM059_Apprenticeship.descript: If you have fewer occupations than every other player, you may immediately play one occupation for free. Afterwards, pass this card to the next player, who adds it to their hand.
messages.cardFaces.CWM059_Apprenticeship.name: Apprenticeship
messages.cardFaces.CWM060_Attic.description: Whenever you build rooms, you may place 1 <WOOD> from your supply on each new room. Each such <WOOD> is worth 1 bonus <SCORE> at the end of the game.
messages.cardFaces.CWM060_Attic.name: Attic
messages.cardFaces.CWM061_BackDoor.description: Immediately place another person on the __Wish for Children__ action space, even if it is occupied. Afterwards, pass this card to the next player, who adds it to their hand.
messages.cardFaces.CWM061_BackDoor.name: Back Door
messages.cardFaces.CWM063_Birdcage.description: At the end of each harvest, you may pay 1 <FOOD> for 1 bonus <SCORE>. Your house can no longer hold animals, even through card effects.
messages.cardFaces.CWM063_Birdcage.name: Birdcage
messages.cardFaces.CWM064_Bonre.description: Place 1 <WOOD> from the supply on an unused farmyard space. At any time, return the <WOOD> to convert animals to <FOOD> for the rest of that round: 1 per <SHEEP>, 2 per <BOAR>, or 3 per <CATTLE>.
messages.cardFaces.CWM064_Bonre.name: Bonfire
messages.cardFaces.CWM065_BoundaryStones.descript: At the end of the game, count farmyard <FIELD> tiles with exactly one orthogonally adjacent <FIELD> tile. Having 2, 3, 4, or at least 5 such <FIELD> gives you 1, 2, 3, or 5 bonus <SCORE>, respectively.
messages.cardFaces.CWM065_BoundaryStones.name: Boundary Stones
messages.cardFaces.CWM066_Brazier.description: During each harvest feeding phase, you may convert at most one good to <FOOD>: 1 <VEGETABLE> for 3 <FOOD>, 1 <SHEEP> for 2 <FOOD>, 1 <BOAR> for 3 <FOOD>, or 1 <CATTLE> for 4 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.CWM066_Brazier.name: Brazier
messages.cardFaces.CWM067_BuriedTreasure.descript: Whenever you use __Farmland__ or __Cultivation__, you also get 1 <STONE>.
messages.cardFaces.CWM067_BuriedTreasure.name: Buried Treasure
messages.cardFaces.CWM068_CashCrop.description: When you __Sow__, you may __Sow__ on this card as if it were 1 <FIELD>. Whenever you harvest goods from this card during the field phase of a harvest, you must exchange these harvested goods for 1 bonus <SCORE> each.
messages.cardFaces.CWM068_CashCrop.name: Cash Crop
messages.cardFaces.CWM069_ChangingPlans.descripti: Immediately return up to 2 built <STABLE> to your supply. For each <STABLE> returned, you may plow 1 <FIELD>. Afterwards, pass this card to the next player, who adds it to their hand.
messages.cardFaces.CWM069_ChangingPlans.name: Changing Plans
messages.cardFaces.CWM070_ClockworkMan.descriptio: This counts as both one occupation and one minor improvement for prerequisites, effects, counts, and scoring, but is only one card. It does not increase later occupation costs or trigger effects for playing an occupation card, such as Bookshelf or Lamp Oil.
messages.cardFaces.CWM070_ClockworkMan.name: Clockwork Man
messages.cardFaces.CWM071_Cookies.description: Whenever you bake bread, for each <GRAIN> converted you may place 1 <FOOD> from your supply on a room without such a marker. That <FOOD> can no longer be used and is worth 1 bonus <SCORE> at the end of the game.
messages.cardFaces.CWM071_Cookies.name: Cookies
messages.cardFaces.CWM072_Crib.description: At the end of each work phase, if you took a __Family Growth__ action that round, you may either get 2 <FOOD> or pay 2 <FOOD> for 1 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.cardFaces.CWM072_Crib.name: Crib
messages.cardFaces.CWM073_DiamondMine.description: Place 1 <STONE> on each of the next 2 round spaces. At the start of those rounds, you get the <STONE>.
messages.cardFaces.CWM073_DiamondMine.name: Diamond Mine
messages.cardFaces.CWM074_Donkey.description: One of your pastures can no longer hold animals. Whenever you use __Farmland__ or __Cultivation__, you may plow 1 additional <FIELD>.
messages.cardFaces.CWM074_Donkey.name: Donkey
messages.cardFaces.CWM076_DrainedPond.description: Place a <FIELD> tile on the round space 4 rounds after the current round. At the start of that round, you may pay 1 <FOOD> to plow that <FIELD>.
messages.cardFaces.CWM076_DrainedPond.name: Drained Pond
messages.cardFaces.CWM078_FarmSchool.description: During each harvest field phase, if you harvested at least 2 goods, you may pay 2 <FOOD> to play an occupation. Goods harvested from card <FIELD> count; an extra field phase supplied by a card does not.
messages.cardFaces.CWM078_FarmSchool.name: Farm School
messages.cardFaces.CWM079_FestivalHall.descriptio: After each harvest field phase, you may convert at most 1 <GRAIN> into 2 <FOOD> and 1 building resource of your choice. Card <FIELD> count toward the prerequisite; an extra field phase supplied by a card does not trigger this effect.
messages.cardFaces.CWM079_FestivalHall.name: Festival Hall
messages.cardFaces.CWM080_FishHook.description: Whenever you use an action space orthogonally adjacent to __Fishing__, you may immediately take 1 <FOOD> from the __Fishing__ accumulation space.
messages.cardFaces.CWM080_FishHook.name: Fish Hook
messages.cardFaces.CWM082_FlowerPots.description: If played in round 6 or earlier, place 1 <VEGETABLE> on round 8. At the start of round 8, you get it.
messages.cardFaces.CWM082_FlowerPots.name: Flower Pots
messages.cardFaces.CWM083_FreeRangeChickens.descr: At the start of each round, if you have at least one <GRAIN> <FIELD>, place 1 <FOOD> from the supply on this card. You may take its <FOOD> at any time. At the end of the game, at least 3 or 6 <FOOD> remaining here gives 1 or 2 bonus <SCORE>. Card <FIELD> count as <GRAIN> <FIELD>.
messages.cardFaces.CWM083_FreeRangeChickens.name: Free Range Chickens
messages.cardFaces.CWM085_Fruitcake.description: During the next harvest feeding phase only, each of your family members, including newborns, requires 1 less <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.CWM085_Fruitcake.name: Fruitcake
messages.cardFaces.CWM086_GlassblowersShop.descri: Each harvest, you may convert at most 1 <CLAY> into 3 <FOOD>. At the end of the game, having at least 2, 4, or 5 <CLAY> gives 1, 2, or 3 bonus <SCORE>. The same <CLAY> cannot also score for Pottery. This card counts as both a major and a minor improvement, but only one improvement.
messages.cardFaces.CWM086_GlassblowersShop.name: Glassblower's Shop
messages.cardFaces.CWM087_GoldMedal.description: Choose <GRAIN>, <VEGETABLE>, <SHEEP>, <BOAR>, <CATTLE>, <FIELD>, pastures, or fenced <STABLE> when you play this card. At the end of the game, every player tied for the highest normal score in that category gets 2 bonus <SCORE>. Ignore other cards' bonus <SCORE>.
messages.cardFaces.CWM087_GoldMedal.name: Gold Medal
messages.cardFaces.CWM088_GrainElevator.descripti: At the start of each round, add 1 <GRAIN> from the supply unless the number of <GRAIN> on this card equals the player count. When you use __Grain Seeds__, take all <GRAIN> here. When another player uses it, discard all <GRAIN> here.
messages.cardFaces.CWM088_GrainElevator.name: Grain Elevator
messages.cardFaces.CWM089_HomeGarden.description: Whenever you renovate, place 1 <FOOD> on each of the next 3 round spaces. You also do this when playing this card if you renovated earlier in the current turn. At the start of those rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.CWM089_HomeGarden.name: Home Garden
messages.cardFaces.CWM091_IronPlow.description: Once during the game, when you use the __space:farmland|Farmland__ action space, you may plow 2 <FIELD> instead of 1 and take a __Sow__ action afterward.
messages.cardFaces.CWM091_IronPlow.name: Iron Plow
messages.cardFaces.CWM092_Keys.description: You may use __Farm Expansion__ when occupied by another player, but not when occupied by yourself. This does not apply to the 5-player Build 1 Room action space.
messages.cardFaces.CWM092_Keys.name: Keys
messages.cardFaces.CWM093_Kindling.description: Fireplaces and Cooking Hearths count as minor improvements for you and cost 1 <CLAY> less.
messages.cardFaces.CWM093_Kindling.name: Kindling
messages.cardFaces.CWM094_LampOil.description: Immediately before you play an occupation card, you get 1 <FOOD>. Its prerequisite requires 2 animals of any types, excluding animals kept on cards.
messages.cardFaces.CWM094_LampOil.name: Lamp Oil
messages.cardFaces.CWM095_MountainCave.descriptio: Each harvest, you may convert at most 1 <WOOD> into 1 <STONE>.
messages.cardFaces.CWM095_MountainCave.name: Mountain Cave
messages.cardFaces.CWM096_OakCask.description: Immediately place 1 <FOOD> from the supply on this card. During each harvest field phase, if any <FOOD> remains here, add 1 <FOOD>. You may take its <FOOD> at any time.
messages.cardFaces.CWM096_OakCask.name: Oak Cask
messages.cardFaces.CWM097_OpenGate.description: Before each harvest feeding phase, you may pay at most 1 <SHEEP> for 1 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.cardFaces.CWM097_OpenGate.name: Open Gate
messages.cardFaces.CWM098_PettingZoo.description: At the end of the game, if you have all three animal types outside cards, get 1 bonus <SCORE> for having at least 2 <SHEEP> and 1 bonus <SCORE> for having at least 2 <BOAR>. You may receive both.
messages.cardFaces.CWM098_PettingZoo.name: Petting Zoo
messages.cardFaces.CWM100_PlumPatch.description: Count your sown <FIELD> and place 1 <FOOD> on each of that many subsequent round spaces. At the start of those rounds, you get the <FOOD>. Card <FIELD> count for both the prerequisite and this count; each sown card counts as one <FIELD>.
messages.cardFaces.CWM100_PlumPatch.name: Plum Patch
messages.cardFaces.CWM101_PrizewinningSheep.descr: Immediately get 1 building resource of your choice. Afterwards, pass this card to the next player, who adds it to their hand.
messages.cardFaces.CWM101_PrizewinningSheep.name: Prizewinning Sheep
messages.cardFaces.CWM103_Raspberries.description: Place 1 <FOOD> from the supply on each of up to 3 unused farmyard spaces. When a marked space becomes used, you get its <FOOD>. The <FOOD> markers do not themselves make spaces used.
messages.cardFaces.CWM103_Raspberries.name: Raspberries
messages.cardFaces.CWM105_RotherhamPlow.descripti: Whenever you use the __space:farmland|Farmland__ action space, you may plow 2 <FIELD> if they are not diagonally or orthogonally adjacent to each other instead of 1.
messages.cardFaces.CWM105_RotherhamPlow.name: Rotherham Plow
messages.cardFaces.CWM106_Ruins.description: Immediately place 4 <STONE> on this card. During each harvest field phase, take 1 <STONE> from it.
messages.cardFaces.CWM106_Ruins.name: Ruins
messages.cardFaces.CWM107_SlapdashRenovation.desc: After you use an action space providing renovation, return that person home at the end of that turn and place them again on a later turn. Renovations or action spaces supplied by cards do not qualify.
messages.cardFaces.CWM107_SlapdashRenovation.name: Slapdash Renovation
messages.cardFaces.CWM108_Steamer.description: At any time, you may convert 1 <GRAIN> together with 1 <VEGETABLE>, <SHEEP>, <BOAR>, or <CATTLE> into 5, 4, 5, or 6 <FOOD>, respectively.
messages.cardFaces.CWM108_Steamer.name: Steamer
messages.cardFaces.CWM109_SteelPlow.description: Once during the game, when you use either the __space:farmland|Farmland__ or __space:cultivation|Cultivation__ action space, you can plow up to 4 <FIELD> instead of 1.
messages.cardFaces.CWM109_SteelPlow.name: Steel Plow
messages.cardFaces.CWM111_UndisturbedPond.descrip: Count the full rounds already completed. Place 1 <FOOD> on each of that many subsequent round spaces. At the start of those rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.CWM111_UndisturbedPond.name: Undisturbed Pond
messages.cardFaces.CWM112_VillageSchool.descripti: Once per turn, when paying a cost, you may discard 1 card from your hand to pay 1 less building resource of your choice.
messages.cardFaces.CWM112_VillageSchool.name: Village School
messages.cardFaces.CWM113_WildBreeding.descriptio: Add 1 animal to each animal accumulation space containing at least 2 animals. If you have housing capacity, you may take at most one of the newly added animals. Afterwards, pass this card to the next player, who adds it to their hand.
messages.cardFaces.CWM113_WildBreeding.name: Wild Breeding
messages.cardFaces.CWM114_WineCloset.description: Immediately get 1 <VEGETABLE>. Once per round, you may place 1 <VEGETABLE> on a future round space. If it is at least 5 rounds ahead, add a second <VEGETABLE> from the supply. At the start of that round, each <VEGETABLE> there must become either 2 <FOOD> or 1 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.cardFaces.CWM114_WineCloset.name: Wine Closet
messages.cardFaces.CWM115_WormBait.description: Whenever you use __Farmland__, put 2 <FOOD> from the supply on this card. Whenever you use __Fishing__, take all its <FOOD>. At the start of each harvest, return 1 <FOOD> from this card.
messages.cardFaces.CWM115_WormBait.name: Worm Bait
messages.cardFaces.CZ314_Keg.description: After everyone has placed their people this round, you may place a Guest to take an extra action. Pass this card to the player on your left to add to their hand.
messages.cardFaces.CZ314_Keg.name: Keg
messages.cardFaces.D001_ZigzagHarrow.description: You can immediately plow 1 <FIELD> such that it completes a "zigzag" pattern.
messages.cardFaces.D001_ZigzagHarrow.name: Zigzag Harrow
messages.cardFaces.D002_DwellingPlan.description: You can immediately take a __Renovation__ action.
messages.cardFaces.D002_DwellingPlan.name: Dwelling Plan
messages.cardFaces.D003_Furrows.description: You can immediately sow in exactly 1 <FIELD>.
messages.cardFaces.D003_Furrows.name: Furrows
messages.cardFaces.D004_CrossCutWood.description: You immediately get a number of <WOOD> equal to the number of <STONE> in your supply.
messages.cardFaces.D004_CrossCutWood.name: Cross-Cut Wood
messages.cardFaces.D005_FieldClay.description: You immediately get 1 <CLAY> for each planted <FIELD> you have.
messages.cardFaces.D005_FieldClay.name: Field Clay
messages.cardFaces.D006_PetrifiedWood.description: Immediately exchange up to 3 <WOOD> for 1 <STONE> each.
messages.cardFaces.D006_PetrifiedWood.name: Petrified Wood
messages.cardFaces.D007_Trident.description: If you play this card in round 3/6/9/12, you immediately get 3/4/5/6 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.D007_Trident.name: Trident
messages.cardFaces.D008_FernSeeds.description: You get 2 <FOOD> and 1 <GRAIN>, which you must sow immediately.
messages.cardFaces.D008_FernSeeds.name: Fern Seeds
messages.cardFaces.D009_GameTrade.description: You immediately get 1 <PIG> and 1 <CATTLE>. (effectively, you are exchanging 2 <SHEEP> for 1 <PIG> and 1 <CATTLE>.)
messages.cardFaces.D009_GameTrade.name: Game Trade
messages.cardFaces.D010_StorksNest.description: In the returning home phase of each round, if you have more rooms than people, you can pay 1 <FOOD> to take a __Family Growth__ action.
messages.cardFaces.D010_StorksNest.name: Stork's Nest
messages.cardFaces.D011_LawnFertilizer.descriptio: Your pastures of size 1 can hold up to 3 animals of the same type. (With a <STABLE>, they can hold up to 6 animals of the same type.)
messages.cardFaces.D011_LawnFertilizer.name: Lawn Fertilizer
messages.cardFaces.D012_MilkingPlace.description: In the feeding phase of each harvest, you get 1 <FOOD>. You can no longer hold animals in your house (not even via another card).
messages.cardFaces.D012_MilkingPlace.name: Milking Place
messages.cardFaces.D013_Trowel.description: At any time, you can renovate your house to <STONE>. From a wooden house, this costs 1 <STONE>, 1 <REED>, and 1 <FOOD> per room. From a clay house, this costs 1 <STONE> per room.
messages.cardFaces.D013_Trowel.name: Trowel
messages.cardFaces.D014_HammerCrusher.description: Immediately before you renovate to stone, you get 2 <CLAY> and 1 <REED> and you can take a __Build Rooms__ action.
messages.cardFaces.D014_HammerCrusher.name: Hammer Crusher
messages.cardFaces.D015_ClaySupports.description: Each time you build a clay room, you can pay 2 <CLAY>, 1 <WOOD>, and 1 <REED> instead of 5 <CLAY> and 2 <REED>.
messages.cardFaces.D015_ClaySupports.name: Clay Supports
messages.cardFaces.D016_WoodenWheyBucket.descript: Each time before you use the __space:sheep-market|Sheep Market__/__space:cattle-market|Cattle Market__ accumulation space, you can build exactly 1 <STABLE> for 1 <WOOD>/at no cost.
messages.cardFaces.D016_WoodenWheyBucket.name: Wooden Whey Bucket
messages.cardFaces.D017_DrillHarrow.description: Each time before you take an unconditional __Sow__ action, you can pay 3 <FOOD> to plow 1 <FIELD>.
messages.cardFaces.D017_DrillHarrow.name: Drill Harrow
messages.cardFaces.D018_SteamPlow.description: Immediately after each returning home phase, you can pay 2 <WOOD> and 1 <FOOD> to use the __space:farmland|Farmland__ action space without placing a person.
messages.cardFaces.D018_SteamPlow.name: Steam Plow
messages.cardFaces.D019_PulverizerPlow.descriptio: Immediately after each time you use a <CLAY> accumulation space, you can pay 1 <CLAY> to plow 1 <FIELD>. If you do, place that 1 <CLAY> on the accumulation space.
messages.cardFaces.D019_PulverizerPlow.name: Pulverizer Plow
messages.cardFaces.D020_TurnwrestPlow.description: Place 2 field tiles on this card. Each time you use the __space:farmland|Farmland__ or __space:cultivation|Cultivation__ action space, you can also plow up to 2 fields from this card.
messages.cardFaces.D020_TurnwrestPlow.name: Turnwrest Plow
messages.cardFaces.D021_Recruitment.description: From round 5 on, provided you have room in your house, each time you get a __Minor Improvement__ action, you can take a __Family Growth__ action instead.
messages.cardFaces.D021_Recruitment.name: Recruitment
messages.cardFaces.D021_Recruitment.prerequisite: No People Left in the House
messages.cardFaces.D022_WorkPermit.description: Add 1 to the current round for each building resource you have and place 1 person from your supply on the corresponding round space. In that round, you can use the person.
messages.cardFaces.D022_WorkPermit.name: Work Permit
messages.cardFaces.D023_PioneeringSpirit.descript: This card is an action space for you only. In rounds 3-5, it provides a __Renovation__ action. In rounds 6-8, it provides your choice of 1 <VEGETABLE>, <PIG>, or <CATTLE>.
messages.cardFaces.D023_PioneeringSpirit.name: Pioneering Spirit
messages.cardFaces.D024_BrotherlyLove.description: As long as you have exactly 4 people, in the work phase of each round, you can place your third and fourth person immediately after one another, even on the same action space.
messages.cardFaces.D024_BrotherlyLove.name: Brotherly Love
messages.cardFaces.D025_WitchesDanceFloor.descrip: This card is a field that you can sow in, an occupation, and the "Fireplace" major improvement with all of its effects. You can play it only via a __Minor Improvement__ action.
messages.cardFaces.D025_WitchesDanceFloor.name: Witches' Dance Floor
messages.cardFaces.D026_CarpentersYard.descriptio: You can build the __Joinery__ and __Well__ major improvement even when taking a __Minor Improvement__ action, or you can build both with a single __Major Improvement__ action.
messages.cardFaces.D026_CarpentersYard.name: Carpenter's Yard
messages.cardFaces.D027_Retraining.description: At the end of each turn in which you renovate, you can exchange your __Joinery__ for the __Pottery__ or your __Pottery__ for the __Basketmaker\\
messages.cardFaces.D027_Retraining.name: Retraining
messages.cardFaces.D028_WritingDesk.description: Each time you use a __space:lessons,lessons-3,lessons-4,lessons-56-2f,lessons-56-variable|Lessons__ action space, you can play 1 additional occupation for an occupation cost of 2 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.D028_WritingDesk.name: Writing Desk
messages.cardFaces.D029_MuckRake.description: During scoring, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for exactly 1 unfenced <STABLE> holding exactly 1 <SHEEP>. The same applies to <PIG> and <CATTLE>, if held in different unfenced <STABLE>.
messages.cardFaces.D029_MuckRake.name: Muck Rake
messages.cardFaces.D030_ArtisanDistrict.descripti: During scoring, you get 2/5/8 bonus <SCORE> for having 3/4/5 major improvements from the bottom row of the supply board.
messages.cardFaces.D030_ArtisanDistrict.name: Artisan District
messages.cardFaces.D031_Storeroom.description: During scoring, you get ½ bonus <SCORE> for each pair of <GRAIN> plus <VEGETABLE> you have (considering all crops in your supply and <FIELD>), rounded up.
messages.cardFaces.D031_Storeroom.name: Storeroom
messages.cardFaces.D032_WoodRake.description: During scoring, if you had at least 7 goods in your <FIELD> before the final harvest, you get 2 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.cardFaces.D032_WoodRake.name: Wood Rake
messages.cardFaces.D033_SummerHouse.description: During scoring, if you live in a stone house, you get 2 bonus <SCORE> for each unused farmyard space orthogonally adjacent to your house. (You still lose the points for these unused spaces.)
messages.cardFaces.D033_SummerHouse.name: Summer House
messages.cardFaces.D034_LuxuriousHostel.descripti: During scoring, if you then have more stone rooms than people, you get 4 bonus <SCORE>. You can only use one card to get bonus <SCORE> for your stone house.
messages.cardFaces.D034_LuxuriousHostel.name: Luxurious Hostel
messages.cardFaces.D035_FodderChamber.description: During scoring in a game with 1/2/3/4+ players, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for every 7th/5th/4th/3rd animal on your farm.
messages.cardFaces.D035_FodderChamber.name: Fodder Chamber
messages.cardFaces.D036_BreedRegistry.description: During scoring, if you gained at most 2 <SHEEP> from sources other than breeding during the game and have not turned any sheep into food, you get 3 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.cardFaces.D036_BreedRegistry.name: Breed Registry
messages.cardFaces.D037_Sculpture.description: You can only play this card if there are more complete rounds left to play than you have unused farmyard spaces.
messages.cardFaces.D037_Sculpture.name: Sculpture
messages.cardFaces.D038_MilkingStool.description: In the field phase of each harvest, if you have at least 1/3/5 <CATTLE>, you get 1/2/3 <FOOD>. During scoring, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for every 2 <CATTLE> you have.
messages.cardFaces.D038_MilkingStool.name: Milking Stool
messages.cardFaces.D039_TruffleSlicer.description: Each time you use a <WOOD> accumulation space, if you have at least 1 <PIG>, you can pay 1 <FOOD> for 1 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.cardFaces.D039_TruffleSlicer.name: Truffle Slicer
messages.cardFaces.D040_Cesspit.description: Alternate placing 1 <CLAY> and 1 <PIG> on each remaining round space, starting with <CLAY>. At the start of these rounds, you get the respective good.
messages.cardFaces.D040_Cesspit.name: Cesspit
messages.cardFaces.D041_HorseDrawnBoat.descriptio: Alternate placing 1 <FOOD> and 1 <SHEEP> on each remaining round space, starting with <FOOD>. At the start of these rounds, you get the respective good.
messages.cardFaces.D041_HorseDrawnBoat.name: Horse-Drawn Boat
messages.cardFaces.D042_EducationBonus.descriptio: After you play your 1st/2nd/3rd/4th/5th/6th occupation this game, you immediately get 1 <GRAIN>/<CLAY>/<REED>/<STONE>/<VEGETABLE>/<FIELD> (not retroactively).
messages.cardFaces.D042_EducationBonus.name: Education Bonus
messages.cardFaces.D043_Hutch.description: Place 0, 1, 2, and 3 <FOOD> in this order on the next 4 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.D043_Hutch.name: Hutch
messages.cardFaces.D044_ForestWell.description: Place 1 <FOOD> on each remaining round space, up to the amount of <WOOD> in your supply. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.D044_ForestWell.name: Forest Well
messages.cardFaces.D045_SheepWell.description: Place 1 <FOOD> on each of the next round spaces, up to the number of <SHEEP> you have. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.D045_SheepWell.name: Sheep Well
messages.cardFaces.D046_PelletPress.description: Once per round, you can pay 1 <REED>. If you do, place 1 <FOOD> on each of the next 4 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.D046_PelletPress.name: Pellet Press
messages.cardFaces.D047_Churchyard.description: Place 2 <FOOD> on each remaining round space. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>. (*Occupations and Improvements)
messages.cardFaces.D047_Churchyard.name: Churchyard
messages.cardFaces.D048_CivicFacade.description: Before the start of each round, if you have more occupations than improvements in your hand, you get 1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.D048_CivicFacade.name: Civic Facade
messages.cardFaces.D049_Bookshelf.description: Immediately before each time you play an occupation (even before paying the occupation cost), you get 3 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.D049_Bookshelf.name: Bookshelf
messages.cardFaces.D050_ForeignAid.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 6 <FOOD>. You may no longer use the action spaces of rounds 12 to 14.
messages.cardFaces.D050_ForeignAid.name: Foreign Aid
messages.cardFaces.D051_Archway.description: This card is an action space for all. A player who uses it immediately gets 1 <FOOD>. Immediately before the returning home phase, they can use an unoccupied action space with the person from this card.
messages.cardFaces.D051_Archway.name: Archway
messages.cardFaces.D052_RollingPin.description: In the returning home phase of each round, if you have more <CLAY> than <WOOD> in your supply, you get 1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.D052_RollingPin.name: Rolling Pin
messages.cardFaces.D053_TeaHouse.description: Once per round, you can skip placing your second person and get 1 <FOOD> instead. (You can place the person later that round.)
messages.cardFaces.D053_TeaHouse.name: Tea House
messages.cardFaces.D054_TroutPool.description: At the start of each work phase, if there are at least 3 <FOOD> on the __space:fishing|Fishing__ accumulation space, you get 1 <FOOD> from the general supply.
messages.cardFaces.D054_TroutPool.name: Trout Pool
messages.cardFaces.D055_NewMarket.description: Each time you use an action space card on round spaces 8 to 11, you get 1 additional <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.D055_NewMarket.name: New Market
messages.cardFaces.D056_FatstockStretcher.descrip: Each time you turn a <SHEEP> or <PIG> into <FOOD> using a cooking improvement, you get 1 additional <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.D056_FatstockStretcher.name: Fatstock Stretcher
messages.cardFaces.D057_WholesaleMarket.descripti: Place 1 <FOOD> on each remaining round space. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.D057_WholesaleMarket.name: Wholesale Market
messages.cardFaces.D058_Gritter.description: At the end of each action in which you sow <VEGETABLE> in a <FIELD>, you get 1 <FOOD> for each <VEGETABLE> <FIELD> you have (including the new ones).
messages.cardFaces.D058_Gritter.name: Gritter
messages.cardFaces.D059_EarthOven.name: Earth Oven
messages.cardFaces.D060_LargePottery.name: Large Pottery
messages.cardFaces.D061_BaleofStraw.description: At the start of each harvest, if you have at least 3 <GRAIN> <FIELD> (including <FIELD> cards with planted <GRAIN>), you get 2 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.D061_BaleofStraw.name: Bale of Straw
messages.cardFaces.D062_BeerTap.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 2 <FOOD>. In the feeding phase of each harvest, you can turn 2/3/4 <GRAIN> into 3/6/9 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.D062_BeerTap.name: Beer Tap
messages.cardFaces.D063_Lynchet.description: In the field phase of each harvest, you get 1 <FOOD> for each harvested <FIELD> tile that is orthogonally adjacent to your house.
messages.cardFaces.D063_Lynchet.name: Lynchet
messages.cardFaces.D064_BakingCourse.description:
[__Bake Bread__ action:]
<GRAIN> <ARROW> 2<FOOD>
At the end of each round that does not end with a harvest, you can take a __Bake Bread__ action.
messages.cardFaces.D064_BakingCourse.name: Baking Course
messages.cardFaces.D065_GrainSieve.description: In the field phase of each harvest, if you harvest at least 2 <GRAIN>, you get 1 additional <GRAIN> from the general supply.
messages.cardFaces.D065_GrainSieve.name: Grain Sieve
messages.cardFaces.D066_PotterCeramics.descriptio: Each time before you take a __Bake Bread__ action, you can exchange 1 <CLAY> for 1 <GRAIN>.
messages.cardFaces.D066_PotterCeramics.name: Potter Ceramics
messages.cardFaces.D067_ReapHook.description: Place 1 <GRAIN> on each of the next 3 of the round spaces 4, 7, 9, 11, 13, and 14. At the start of these rounds, you get the <GRAIN>.
messages.cardFaces.D067_ReapHook.name: Reap Hook
messages.cardFaces.D068_SmallBasket.description: Each time after you use the __space:reed-bank|Reed Bank__ accumulation space, you can pay 1 <REED> to get 1 <VEGETABLE>. If you do in a game with 4+ players, place that 1 <REED> on the accumulation space.
messages.cardFaces.D068_SmallBasket.name: Small Basket
messages.cardFaces.D069_SmallGreenhouse.descripti: Add 4 and 7 to the current round and place 1 <VEGETABLE> on each corresponding round space. At the start of these rounds, you can buy the <VEGETABLE> for 1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.D069_SmallGreenhouse.name: Small Greenhouse
messages.cardFaces.D070_StrawManure.description: Before the field phase of each harvest, you can pay 1 <GRAIN> from your supply to add 1 <VEGETABLE> to each of up to 2 vegetable fields.
messages.cardFaces.D070_StrawManure.name: Straw Manure
messages.cardFaces.D071_Changeover.description: At any time, if a field contains exactly 1 good as a result of a harvest, you can discard that good and immediately take a __Sow__ action limited to that field.
messages.cardFaces.D071_Changeover.name: Changeover
messages.cardFaces.D072_StableManure.description: In the field phase of each harvest, you can harvest 1 additional good from a number of fields equal to the number of unfenced stables you have.
messages.cardFaces.D072_StableManure.name: Stable Manure
messages.cardFaces.D073_SupplyBoat.description: Each time after you use the __space:fishing|Fishing__ accumulation space, you can choose to buy 1 <GRAIN> for 1 <FOOD>, or 1 <VEGETABLE> for 3 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.D073_SupplyBoat.name: Supply Boat
messages.cardFaces.D074_RoyalWood.description: At the end of each turn in which you use the __space:farm-expansion|Farm Expansion__ action space or build an improvement, you get 1 <WOOD> back for every 2 <WOOD> paid during those actions (rounded down).
messages.cardFaces.D074_RoyalWood.name: Royal Wood
messages.cardFaces.D075_WoodField.description: You can plant <WOOD> on this card as though it were 2 <FIELD>, but it is considered 1 <FIELD>. Sow and harvest <WOOD> on this card as you would <GRAIN>.
messages.cardFaces.D075_WoodField.name: Wood Field
messages.cardFaces.D076_SocialBenefits.descriptio: Immediately after the feeding phase of each harvest, if you have no <FOOD> left, you get 1 <WOOD> and 1 <CLAY>.
messages.cardFaces.D076_SocialBenefits.name: Social Benefits
messages.cardFaces.D077_RecycledBrick.description: Each time any player (including you) renovates to <STONE>, you get 1 <CLAY> for each newly renovated room.
messages.cardFaces.D077_RecycledBrick.name: Recycled Brick
messages.cardFaces.D078_ReedPond.description: Place 1 <REED> on each of the next 3 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <REED>.
messages.cardFaces.D078_ReedPond.name: Reed Pond
messages.cardFaces.D079_CarrotMuseum.description: At the end of rounds 8, 10, and 12, you get 1 <STONE> for each <VEGETABLE> <FIELD> you have and a number of <WOOD> equal to the number of <VEGETABLE> in your supply.
messages.cardFaces.D079_CarrotMuseum.name: Carrot Museum
messages.cardFaces.D080_BrickHammer.description: Each time after you build an improvement costing at least 2 <CLAY>, you get 1 <STONE>.
messages.cardFaces.D080_BrickHammer.name: Brick Hammer
messages.cardFaces.D081_RoofLadder.description: Each time you renovate, you pay 1 fewer <REED> and, at the end of the action, you get 1 <STONE>.
messages.cardFaces.D081_RoofLadder.name: Roof Ladder
messages.cardFaces.D082_HuntingTrophy.description:
To play this card, you must return or cook 1 <PIG>.
Improvements built on __space:house-redevelopment|House Redevelopment__ cost you 1 building resource of your choice less. <FENCE> built on __space:farm-redevelopment|Farm Redevelopment__ cost you a total of 3 <WOOD> less.
messages.cardFaces.D082_HuntingTrophy.name: Hunting Trophy
messages.cardFaces.D083_Pigswill.description: Each time you use the __space:fencing|Fencing__ action space, you also get 1 <PIG>.
messages.cardFaces.D083_Pigswill.name: Pigswill
messages.cardFaces.D084_FeedPellets.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <SHEEP>. In the feeding phase of each harvest, you can exchange exactly 1 <VEGETABLE> for 1 animal of a type you already have.
messages.cardFaces.D084_FeedPellets.name: Feed Pellets
messages.cardFaces.D085_Reader.description: As soon as you have 6 (7 in draft mode) occupations in front of you (including this one), this card provides room for one person.
messages.cardFaces.D085_Reader.name: Reader
messages.cardFaces.D085_Reader.rules: In simultaneous draft mode, the occupation threshold is fixed at 7, regardless of draft pool size.
messages.cardFaces.D086_SheepAgent.description: You can keep 1 <SHEEP> on this card for each occupation card in front of you (including this one), unless it is already able to hold animals.
messages.cardFaces.D086_SheepAgent.name: Sheep Agent
messages.cardFaces.D087_MasterBuilder.description: Once your house has at least 5 rooms, at any time, but only once this game, you can add another room at no cost.
messages.cardFaces.D087_MasterBuilder.name: Master Builder
messages.cardFaces.D088_Millwright.description: You immediately get 1 <GRAIN>. Each time you build <FENCE>, <STABLE>, and rooms, or renovate your house, you can replace up to 2 building resources of any type with 1 <GRAIN> each.
messages.cardFaces.D088_Millwright.name: Millwright
messages.cardFaces.D089_Stablehand.description: Each time you build at least 1 <FENCE>, you can also build a <STABLE> without paying <WOOD> for the <STABLE>.
messages.cardFaces.D089_Stablehand.name: Stablehand
messages.cardFaces.D090_PlowMaker.description: Each time you use the __space:farmland|Farmland__ or __space:cultivation|Cultivation__ action space, you can pay 1 <FOOD> to plow 1 additional <FIELD>.
messages.cardFaces.D090_PlowMaker.name: Plow Maker
messages.cardFaces.D091_Plowman.description: Add 4, 7, and 10 to the current round and place a <FIELD> tile on each corresponding round space. At the start of these rounds, you can plow the <FIELD> for 1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.D091_Plowman.name: Plowman
messages.cardFaces.D092_ChildOmbudsman.descriptio: From round 5 on, if you have room in your house, at the end of each person action, you can take a __Family Growth__ action with that person. If you do, you get 2 negative <SCORE>.
messages.cardFaces.D092_ChildOmbudsman.name: Child Ombudsman
messages.cardFaces.D093_SheepInspector.descriptio: Once per work phase, after you complete a person action, you can pay 1 <SHEEP> and 2 <FOOD> to return another person you placed home, unless it is on the __space:meeting-place|Meeting Place__ action space.
messages.cardFaces.D093_SheepInspector.name: Sheep Inspector
messages.cardFaces.D094_HenpeckedHusband.descript: Each time you take a __Build Rooms__ action with the second person you place, return the first person you placed home, unless it is on the __space:meeting-place|Meeting Place__ action space.
messages.cardFaces.D094_HenpeckedHusband.name: Henpecked Husband
messages.cardFaces.D095_SiteManager.description: When you play this card, immediately build a major improvement. When paying its cost, you can replace up to 1 building resource of each type with 1 <FOOD> each.
messages.cardFaces.D095_SiteManager.name: Site Manager
messages.cardFaces.D096_Furnisher.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 2 <WOOD>. Each time after you build at least one new room, you can build or play a number of improvements equal to the number of new rooms you built, paying up to 1 <WOOD> less for each such improvement.
messages.cardFaces.D096_Furnisher.name: Furnisher
messages.cardFaces.D097_BeggingStudent.descriptio: When you play this card, you must immediately take 1 <BEGGING> marker. At the start of each harvest, you can play 1 occupation without paying an occupation cost.
messages.cardFaces.D097_BeggingStudent.name: Begging Student
messages.cardFaces.D098_Transactor.description: Immediately before the final harvest at the end of round 14, you can take all the building resources that are left on the entire game board.
messages.cardFaces.D098_Transactor.name: Transactor
messages.cardFaces.D099_EarthenwarePotter.descrip: If you play this card in round 4 or before, after the final harvest, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for each person for which you then pay 1 <CLAY>.
messages.cardFaces.D099_EarthenwarePotter.name: Earthenware Potter
messages.cardFaces.D100_LordoftheManor.descriptio: During scoring, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for each scoring category in which you score the maximum 4 points. (The bonus point is also awarded for 4 fenced stables.)
messages.cardFaces.D100_LordoftheManor.name: Lord of the Manor
messages.cardFaces.D101_SugarBaker.description: Each time after you use the __space:grain-utilization|Grain Utilization__ action space, you can buy 1 bonus <SCORE> for 1 <FOOD>. Place the <FOOD> on the action space (for the next visitor).
messages.cardFaces.D101_SugarBaker.name: Sugar Baker
messages.cardFaces.D102_SampleStableMaker.descrip: At the start of each returning home phase, you can return a built stable to your supply to get 1 <WOOD>, 1 <GRAIN>, 1 <FOOD>, and a __Minor Improvement__ action.
messages.cardFaces.D102_SampleStableMaker.name: Sample Stable Maker
messages.cardFaces.D103_CanalBoatman.description: Each time you use __space:fishing|Fishing__ or __space:reed-bank|Reed Bank__, you can pay 1 <FOOD> to immediately place another person on this card. If you do, you get your choice of 3 <STONE> or 1 <GRAIN> plus 1 <VEGETABLE>.
messages.cardFaces.D103_CanalBoatman.name: Canal Boatman
messages.cardFaces.D104_Cultivator.description: For each new <FIELD> tile you get, you also get 1 <WOOD> and 1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.D104_Cultivator.name: Cultivator
messages.cardFaces.D105_Sculptor.description: Each time you use a <CLAY> accumulation space, you also get 1 <FOOD>. Each time you use a <STONE> accumulation space, you also get 1 <GRAIN>.
messages.cardFaces.D105_Sculptor.name: Sculptor
messages.cardFaces.D106_WhiskyDistiller.descripti: At any time, you can pay 1 <GRAIN>. If you do, add 2 to the current round and place 4 <FOOD> on the corresponding round space. At the start of that round, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.D106_WhiskyDistiller.name: Whisky Distiller
messages.cardFaces.D107_Bellfounder.description: In the returning home phase of each round, if you have at least 1 <CLAY>, you can use this card to discard all of your <CLAY> and get your choice of 3 <FOOD> or 1 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.cardFaces.D107_Bellfounder.name: Bellfounder
messages.cardFaces.D108_StoneCarver.description: Each harvest, you can use this card to turn exactly 1 <STONE> into 3 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.D108_StoneCarver.name: Stone Carver
messages.cardFaces.D109_SowingMaster.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <WOOD>. Each time after you use the __space:grain-utilization|Grain Utilization__ or __space:cultivation|Cultivation__ action space, you get 2 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.D109_SowingMaster.name: Sowing Master
messages.cardFaces.D110_FishFarmer.description: Each time there is 1/2/3+ <FOOD> on the __space:fishing|Fishing__ accumulation space, you get an additional 2 <FOOD> on the __space:reed-bank|Reed Bank__/ __space:clay-pit|Clay Pit__/ __space:forest|Forest__ accumulation spaces.
messages.cardFaces.D110_FishFarmer.name: Fish Farmer
messages.cardFaces.D111_InteriorDecorator.descrip: Each time you renovate, place 1 <FOOD> on each of the next 6 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.D111_InteriorDecorator.name: Interior Decorator
messages.cardFaces.D112_YoungFarmer.description: Each time you use the __space:major-improvement|Major Improvement__ action space, you also get 1 <GRAIN> and, afterward, you can take a __Sow__ action.
messages.cardFaces.D112_YoungFarmer.name: Young Farmer
messages.cardFaces.D113_FoodMerchant.description: For each <GRAIN> you harvest from a <FIELD>, you can buy 1 <VEGETABLE> for 3 <FOOD>. If you harvest the last <GRAIN> from a <FIELD>, the <VEGETABLE> costs you only 2 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.D113_FoodMerchant.name: Food Merchant
messages.cardFaces.D114_SeedTrader.description: Place 2 <GRAIN> and 2 <VEGETABLE> on this card. You can buy them at any time. Each <GRAIN> costs 2 <FOOD>; each <VEGETABLE> costs 3 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.D114_SeedTrader.name: Seed Trader
messages.cardFaces.D115_FodderPlanter.description: In the breeding phase of each harvest, for each newborn animal you get, you can sow crops in exactly 1 field.
messages.cardFaces.D115_FodderPlanter.name: Fodder Planter
messages.cardFaces.D116_TreeInspector.description: This card is a 1 <WOOD> accumulation space for you only. Each time the newly revealed action space card is a __space:western-quarry,eastern-quarry|Quarry__ accumulation space, you must discard all <WOOD> from this card.
messages.cardFaces.D116_TreeInspector.name: Tree Inspector
messages.cardFaces.D117_WoodExpert.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 2 <WOOD>. Each improvement costs you up to 2 <WOOD> less, if you pay 1 <FOOD> instead.
messages.cardFaces.D117_WoodExpert.name: Wood Expert
messages.cardFaces.D118_Bonehead.description: When you play this card, immediately place 6 <WOOD> on it. Immediately after each time you play a card from your hand, including this one, you get 1 <WOOD> from this card.
messages.cardFaces.D118_Bonehead.name: Bonehead
messages.cardFaces.D119_WoodBarterer.description: Each time before you use an action space with a __Build Fences__ or __Build Rooms__ action, you can choose to either get 2 <WOOD> or exchange up to 2 <WOOD> for 1 <REED> each.
messages.cardFaces.D119_WoodBarterer.name: Wood Barterer
messages.cardFaces.D120_ClayDeliveryman.descripti: Place 1 <CLAY> on each remaining space for rounds 6 to 14. At the start of these rounds, you get the <CLAY>.
messages.cardFaces.D120_ClayDeliveryman.name: Clay Deliveryman
messages.cardFaces.D121_ClayPlasterer.description: Renovating to <CLAY> only costs you exactly 1 <CLAY> and 1 <REED>. Each clay room only costs you 3 <CLAY> and 2 <REED> to build.
messages.cardFaces.D121_ClayPlasterer.name: Clay Plasterer
messages.cardFaces.D122_ClayCarrier.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 2 <CLAY>. At any time, but only once per round, you can buy 2 <CLAY> for 2 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.D122_ClayCarrier.name: Clay Carrier
messages.cardFaces.D123_RenovationPreparer.descri: For each new <WOOD>/clay room you build, you get 2 <CLAY>/2 <STONE>.
messages.cardFaces.D123_RenovationPreparer.name: Renovation Preparer
messages.cardFaces.D124_Emissary.description: At any time, you can place a good from your supply on this card to get 1 <STONE>. You must place different goods on this card. (<FOOD> is also considered a good.)
messages.cardFaces.D124_Emissary.name: Emissary
messages.cardFaces.D125_ForestTrader.description: Each time you use a <WOOD> or <CLAY> accumulation space, you can also buy exactly 1 building resource. <WOOD>, <CLAY>, and <REED> cost 1 <FOOD> each; <STONE> costs 2 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.D125_ForestTrader.name: Forest Trader
messages.cardFaces.D126_FieldCultivator.descripti: Pile 1 <WOOD>, 1 <CLAY>, 1 <REED>, 1 <STONE>, 1 <REED>, 1 <CLAY>, and 1 <WOOD> on this card. Each time you harvest a field tile, you can also take the top good from the pile.
messages.cardFaces.D126_FieldCultivator.name: Field Cultivator
messages.cardFaces.D127_HardworkingMan.descriptio: This card is an action space for you only. If each other player has more rooms than you, it provides the __Day Laborer__, __Build Rooms__, and __Major Improvement__ actions (all three).
messages.cardFaces.D127_HardworkingMan.name: Hardworking Man
messages.cardFaces.D128_BuildingTycoon.descriptio: Each time after another player builds 1 or more rooms, you can give them 1 <FOOD> to build exactly 1 room yourself. (You must pay the building cost of the room.)
messages.cardFaces.D128_BuildingTycoon.name: Building Tycoon
messages.cardFaces.D129_LumberVirtuoso.descriptio: Each harvest in which you have at least 5 <WOOD> in your supply, you can discard down to 5 <WOOD> to take a __Build Stables__ or __Build Wood Rooms__ action by paying the usual costs.
messages.cardFaces.D129_LumberVirtuoso.name: Lumber Virtuoso
messages.cardFaces.D130_RecreationalCarpenter.des: At the end of each work phase in which you did not use the __space:meeting-place|Meeting Place__ action space, you can take a __Build Rooms__ action without placing a person.
messages.cardFaces.D131_CraftsmanshipPromoter.des: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <STONE>. You can build any of the major improvements in the bottom row of the supply board even when taking a __Minor Improvement__ action.
messages.cardFaces.D132_HideFarmer.description: During scoring, you can pay 1 <FOOD> each for any number of unused farmyard spaces. You do not lose points for these spaces.
messages.cardFaces.D132_HideFarmer.name: Hide Farmer
messages.cardFaces.D133_BeerTentOperator.descript: In the feeding phase of each harvest, you can use this card to turn 1 <WOOD> plus 1 <GRAIN> into 1 bonus <SCORE> and 2 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.D133_BeerTentOperator.name: Beer Tent Operator
messages.cardFaces.D134_OysterEater.description: Each time the __space:fishing|Fishing__ accumulation space is used, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> and must skip placing your next person that round. (You can place the person on a later turn.)
messages.cardFaces.D134_OysterEater.name: Oyster Eater
messages.cardFaces.D135_GardeningHeadOfficial.des: If there are still 3/6/9 complete rounds left to play, you immediately get 2/3/4 <WOOD>. During scoring, each player with the most <VEGETABLE> in their <FIELD> gets 2 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.cardFaces.D136_AnimalActivist.descriptio: If there are still 3/6/9 complete rounds left to play, you immediately get 2/3/4 <WOOD>. During scoring, each player with the most fenced <STABLE> gets 2 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.cardFaces.D136_AnimalActivist.name: Animal Activist
messages.cardFaces.D137_TradeTeacher.description: Each time after you use a __space:lessons,lessons-3,lessons-4,lessons-56-2f,lessons-56-variable|Lessons__ action space, you can buy up to 2 different goods: <GRAIN>, <STONE>, <SHEEP>, and <PIG> for 1 <FOOD> each; <CATTLE> and <VEGETABLE> for 2 <FOOD> each.
messages.cardFaces.D137_TradeTeacher.name: Trade Teacher
messages.cardFaces.D138_PetLover.description: Each time you use an accumulation space providing exactly 1 animal, you can leave it on the space and get one from the general supply instead, as well as 3 <FOOD> and 1 <GRAIN>.
messages.cardFaces.D138_PetLover.name: Pet Lover
messages.cardFaces.D139_Chairman.description: Each time another player uses the __space:meeting-place|Meeting Place__ action space, both they and you get 1 <FOOD> (before taking the actions). If you use it, you get 1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.D139_Chairman.name: Chairman
messages.cardFaces.D140_Loudmouth.description: Each time you take at least 4 building resources or 4 animals from an accumulation space, you also get 1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.D140_Loudmouth.name: Loudmouth
messages.cardFaces.D141_SeedSeller.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <GRAIN>. Each time you use the __space:grain-seeds|Grain Seeds__ action space, you get 1 additional <GRAIN>.
messages.cardFaces.D141_SeedSeller.name: Seed Seller
messages.cardFaces.D142_PotatoPlanter.description: At the end of each work phase in which you occupy the __space:clay-pit|Clay Pit__ or __space:reed-bank|Reed Bank__ accumulation space while the respective other is unoccupied, you get 1 <VEGETABLE>.
messages.cardFaces.D142_PotatoPlanter.name: Potato Planter
messages.cardFaces.D143_TreeCutter.description: Each time you use an accumulation space providing at least 3 goods of the same type except <WOOD>, you get an additional 1 <WOOD>. (<FOOD> is also considered a good.)
messages.cardFaces.D143_TreeCutter.name: Tree Cutter
messages.cardFaces.D144_WaterWorker.description: Each time after you use any of the __space:fishing|Fishing__, __space:reed-bank|Reed Bank__, __space:day-laborer|Day Laborer__ spaces or the action space of round 4, you get 1 additional <REED>.
messages.cardFaces.D144_WaterWorker.name: Water Worker
messages.cardFaces.D145_RoofExaminer.description: When you play this card, if you have 1/2/3/4 major improvements, you immediately get 2/3/4/5 <REED>.
messages.cardFaces.D145_RoofExaminer.name: Roof Examiner
messages.cardFaces.D146_Porter.description: Each time you take at least 4 of the same building resource from an accumulation space, you get 1 additional building resource of the accumulating type and 1 <FOOD>
messages.cardFaces.D146_Porter.name: Porter
messages.cardFaces.D147_TrapBuilder.description: Each time you use the __space:day-laborer|Day Laborer__ action space, place 1 <FOOD>, 1 <FOOD>, and 1 <PIG> on the next 3 round spaces, respectively. At the start of these rounds, you get the good.
messages.cardFaces.D147_TrapBuilder.name: Trap Builder
messages.cardFaces.D148_DomesticianExpert.descrip: You can keep 2 <SHEEP> on the border between each pair of orthogonally adjacent rooms.
messages.cardFaces.D148_DomesticianExpert.name: Domestician Expert
messages.cardFaces.D149_CasualWorker.description: Each time another player uses a __space:western-quarry,eastern-quarry|Quarry__ accumulation space, you can choose to get 1 <FOOD> or build a <STABLE> without paying <WOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.D149_CasualWorker.name: Casual Worker
messages.cardFaces.D150_GodlySpouse.description: Each time you take a __Family Growth__ action with the second person you place in a round, return the first person you placed home, unless it is on the __space:meeting-place|Meeting Place__ action space.
messages.cardFaces.D150_GodlySpouse.name: Godly Spouse
messages.cardFaces.D151_SpinDoctor.description: Immediately after each time you use the __space:traveling-players,traveling-players-56|Traveling Players__ accumulation space, you can place another person on an action space of your choice, regardless whether or not the action space is occupied.
messages.cardFaces.D151_SpinDoctor.name: Spin Doctor
messages.cardFaces.D151_SpinDoctor.rules: No card, including this one, can allow you to use __space:meeting-place|Meeting Place__ if it is already occupied.
messages.cardFaces.D152_Patron.description: Immediately before each time you play an occupation after this one (even before paying the occupation cost), you get 2 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.D152_Patron.name: Patron
messages.cardFaces.D153_WealthyMan.description: At the start of each of the 1st/2nd/3rd/4th/5th/6th harvest, if you have at least 1/2/3/4/5/6 <GRAIN> <FIELD>, you get 1 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.cardFaces.D153_WealthyMan.name: Wealthy Man
messages.cardFaces.D154_ChimneySweep.description: Renovating to <STONE> costs you 2 <STONE> less. During scoring, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for each other player living in a stone house.
messages.cardFaces.D154_ChimneySweep.name: Chimney Sweep
messages.cardFaces.D155_Ebonist.description: Each harvest, you can use this card to turn exactly 1 <WOOD> into 1 <FOOD> and 1 <GRAIN>.
messages.cardFaces.D155_Ebonist.name: Ebonist
messages.cardFaces.D156_RetailDealer.description: Place 3 <GRAIN> and 3 <FOOD> on this card. Each time you use the __space:resource-market,resource-market-4,resource-market-56,moor-resource-market-12|Resource Market__ action space, you also get 1 <GRAIN> and 1 <FOOD> from this card.
messages.cardFaces.D156_RetailDealer.name: Retail Dealer
messages.cardFaces.D157_PartyOrganizer.descriptio: As soon as the next player but you gains their 5th person, you immediately get 8 <FOOD> (not retroactively). During scoring, if only you have 5 people, you get 3 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.cardFaces.D157_PartyOrganizer.name: Party Organizer
messages.cardFaces.D158_BeanCounter.description: Each time you use an action space on round spaces 1 to 8, place 1 <FOOD> on this card. Each time this cards has 3 <FOOD> on it, move the <FOOD> to your supply.
messages.cardFaces.D158_BeanCounter.name: Bean Counter
messages.cardFaces.D159_ReedSeller.description: At any time, you can turn 1 <REED> into 3 <FOOD>. Any other player can prevent this by buying the <REED> for 2 <FOOD> from you. If multiple players are interested, choose one.
messages.cardFaces.D159_ReedSeller.name: Reed Seller
messages.cardFaces.D160_Midwife.description: Each time another player uses the first person they place in a round to take a __Family Growth__ action, you get 1 <GRAIN> from the general supply.
messages.cardFaces.D160_Midwife.name: Midwife
messages.cardFaces.D161_CabbageBuyer.description: Each time any player (including you) renovates and then builds no/1 minor/1 major improvement, you can buy 1 <VEGETABLE> for 3/2/1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.D161_CabbageBuyer.name: Cabbage Buyer
messages.cardFaces.D162_ClayFirer.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 2 <CLAY>. At any time, you can turn <CLAY> into <STONE>: you get 1 <STONE> for 2 <CLAY>, and 2 <STONE> for 3 <CLAY>.
messages.cardFaces.D162_ClayFirer.name: Clay Firer
messages.cardFaces.D163_JourneymanBricklayer.desc: When you play this card, you immediately get 2 <STONE>. Each time another player renovates to <STONE> or builds a stone room, you get 1 <STONE>.
messages.cardFaces.D163_JourneymanBricklayer.name: Journeyman Bricklayer
messages.cardFaces.D164_PetGrower.description: Each time you use an animal accumulation space, if afterward you have no animal in your house, you also get 1 <SHEEP>.
messages.cardFaces.D164_PetGrower.name: Pet Grower
messages.cardFaces.D165_PigStalker.description: Each time you use an animal accumulation space, you get an additional 1 <PIG> if you occupy a Round 1-14 action space which is immediately to the left or right of that accumulation space.
messages.cardFaces.D165_PigStalker.name: Pig Stalker
messages.cardFaces.D166_StableMilker.description: Each time you build at least 2 <STABLE> on the same turn, you also get 1 <CATTLE>.
messages.cardFaces.D166_StableMilker.name: Stable Milker
messages.cardFaces.D167_PureBreeder.description: You immediately get 1 <WOOD>. After each round that does not end with a harvest, you can breed exactly one type of animal. (This is not considered a breeding phase.)
messages.cardFaces.D167_PureBreeder.name: Pure Breeder
messages.cardFaces.D168_Stockman.description: When you build your 2nd/3rd/4th <STABLE>, you immediately get 1 <CATTLE>/<PIG>/<SHEEP>, even if built on the same turn (but not retroactively).
messages.cardFaces.D168_Stockman.name: Stockman
messages.cardFaces.D169_Plowsmith.description: Each time another player takes at least 4 <WOOD> from an accumulation space, you can immediately pay 1 <FOOD> to plow 1 <FIELD>.
messages.cardFaces.D169_Plowsmith.name: Plowsmith
messages.cardFaces.D170_FoldBuilder.description: This card is an action space for all. It provides a __Build Fences__ action and then 1 <SHEEP>. If another player uses it, they must first pay you 1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.D170_FoldBuilder.name: Fold Builder
messages.cardFaces.D171_SeniorTeacher.description: Each time another player pays <FOOD> on a __space:lessons,lessons-3,lessons-4,lessons-56-2f,lessons-56-variable|Lessons__ action space, you get exactly 1 of that <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.D171_SeniorTeacher.name: Senior Teacher
messages.cardFaces.D172_PutcherMaker.description: At any time, you can exchange 1 <REED> for 2 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.D172_PutcherMaker.name: Putcher Maker
messages.cardFaces.D173_TownClerk.description: Each time a major improvement is built, place 1 <FOOD> on this card. Once this game, you can turn this card face down to get the <FOOD> on it.
messages.cardFaces.D173_TownClerk.name: Town Clerk
messages.cardFaces.D174_LoessGardener.description: Each time you use the __space:clay-pit|Clay Pit__ accumulation space, you can also buy 1 <VEGETABLE> for 1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.D174_LoessGardener.name: Loess Gardener
messages.cardFaces.D175_Countryman.description: Each time any player (including you) takes a __Renovation__ action on an action space, you can sow crops in exactly 1 <FIELD>.
messages.cardFaces.D175_Countryman.name: Countryman
messages.cardFaces.D176_Woodshacker.description: In the work phase of each round, the first and the second time you use a <WOOD> accumulation space, you also get 1 and 2 <CLAY> respectively.
messages.cardFaces.D176_Woodshacker.name: Woodshacker
messages.cardFaces.D177_Graduate.description: When you play this card you immediately pay 1 <FOOD>. If you do, you get 2 <STONE> and 2 <REED>.
messages.cardFaces.D177_Graduate.name: Graduate
messages.cardFaces.D178_SubstituteTeacher.descrip: Each time all three __space:lessons,lessons-3,lessons-4,lessons-56-2f,lessons-56-variable|Lessons__ action spaces are occupied, you can use this card with a person to get your choice of 1 building resource or 1 crop of each type.
messages.cardFaces.D178_SubstituteTeacher.name: Substitute Teacher
messages.cardFaces.D179_Bullcatcher.description: When both action spaces on round spaces 3 and 6 are occupied, you can use this card with a person to get 1 <CATTLE> and 2 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.D179_Bullcatcher.name: Bullcatcher
messages.cardFaces.D180_PartTimeWorker.descriptio: Each time you use an accumulation space with exactly 2/4/6 goods on it, you can leave 1/2/3 goods on the space. If you do, you get 1 <SHEEP>/<PIG>/<CATTLE>.
messages.cardFaces.D180_PartTimeWorker.name: Part-Time Worker
messages.cardFaces.E001_PoleBarns.description: You can immediately build up to 3 <STABLE> at no cost. (You must pay the cost of this card though.)
messages.cardFaces.E001_PoleBarns.name: Pole Barns
messages.cardFaces.E002_RenovationMaterials.descr: Immediately renovate to <CLAY> at no cost. (You must pay the cost of this card though.)
messages.cardFaces.E002_RenovationMaterials.name: Renovation Materials
messages.cardFaces.E003_TeaTime.description: Immediately return your person on the __space:grain-utilization|Grain Utilization__ action space home; you can place it again later this round.
messages.cardFaces.E003_TeaTime.name: Tea Time
messages.cardFaces.E004_Thunderbolt.description: Immediately remove all <GRAIN> from one of your fields to the general supply. Gain 2 <WOOD> for each <GRAIN> you just removed.
messages.cardFaces.E004_Thunderbolt.name: Thunderbolt
messages.cardFaces.E005_NightLoot.description: Immediately remove 2 different building resources total from accumulation spaces and place them in your supply.
messages.cardFaces.E005_NightLoot.name: Night Loot
messages.cardFaces.E006_Recount.description: You immediately get 1 building resource of each type of which you have 4 or more resources in your supply already.
messages.cardFaces.E006_Recount.name: Recount
messages.cardFaces.E007_Pumpernickel.description: You immediately get 4 <FOOD>. (Effectively, you are turning 1 <GRAIN> into 4 <FOOD>.)
messages.cardFaces.E007_Pumpernickel.name: Pumpernickel
messages.cardFaces.E008_FarmersMarket.description: You immediately get 1 <VEGETABLE>. (Effectively, you are buying 1 <VEGETABLE> for 2 <FOOD>.)
messages.cardFaces.E008_FarmersMarket.name: Farmer's Market
messages.cardFaces.E009_BarteringHut.description: Up to two times: Immediately spend any 2/3/4 building resources for 1 <SHEEP>/<PIG>/<CATTLE> from the general supply.
messages.cardFaces.E009_BarteringHut.name: Bartering Hut
messages.cardFaces.E010_StrawHat.description: At the end of the work phases of rounds 3 and 6, you can move your person from the __space:farmland|Farmland__ action space to an unoccupied action space and take that action, or get 1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.E010_StrawHat.name: Straw Hat
messages.cardFaces.E011_PettingZoo.description: As long as you have a pasture orthogonally adjacent to your house, you can keep animals of any type on this card, up to the number of rooms in your house.
messages.cardFaces.E011_PettingZoo.name: Petting Zoo
messages.cardFaces.E012_AnimalBedding.description: You can keep 1 additional animal (of the same type) in each of your unfenced <STABLE>, and 2 additional animals (of the same type) in each pasture with <STABLE>.
messages.cardFaces.E012_AnimalBedding.name: Animal Bedding
At any time, you can renovate your clay house to a stone house without placing a person. (You must pay the normal renovation cost.)
messages.cardFaces.E014_WoodSaw.description: Each time all other players have more people than you, you can take a __Build Rooms__ action without placing a person.
messages.cardFaces.E014_WoodSaw.name: Wood Saw
messages.cardFaces.E015_NailBasket.description: Each time after you use a <WOOD> accumulation space, you can place 1 <STONE> from your supply on that space (for the next visitor) to take a __Build Fences__ action.
messages.cardFaces.E015_NailBasket.name: Nail Basket
messages.cardFaces.E016_BriarHedge.description: You do not need to pay wood for fences that you build on the edge of your farmyard board.
messages.cardFaces.E016_BriarHedge.name: Briar Hedge
messages.cardFaces.E017_SkimmerPlow.description: Each time you use the __space:farmland|Farmland__ or __space:cultivation|Cultivation__  action space, you can plow 2 <FIELD> instead of 1. Each time you sow, you must place 1 fewer good on each <FIELD> you sow.
messages.cardFaces.E017_SkimmerPlow.name: Skimmer Plow
messages.cardFaces.E018_SeedAlmanac.description: Each time after you play a minor improvement after this one, you can pay 1 <FOOD> to plow 1 <FIELD>.
messages.cardFaces.E018_SeedAlmanac.name: Seed Almanac
messages.cardFaces.E019_OxGoad.description: Each time after you use the __space:cattle-market|Cattle Market__ accumulation space, you can pay 2 <FOOD> to plow 1 <FIELD>.
messages.cardFaces.E019_OxGoad.name: Ox Goad
messages.cardFaces.E020_IronHoe.description: At the end of each work phase, if you occupy both the __space:grain-seeds|Grain Seeds__ and __space:vegetable-seeds|Vegetable Seeds__ action spaces, you can plow 1 <FIELD>.
messages.cardFaces.E020_IronHoe.name: Iron Hoe
messages.cardFaces.E021_SheepRug.description: You can use any __space:wish-children,urgent-wish-children,modest-wish-children-56|Wish for Children__ action space, even if it is occupied by another player's person.
messages.cardFaces.E021_SheepRug.name: Sheep Rug
messages.cardFaces.E022_GuestRoom.description: Immediately place any amount of <FOOD> from your supply on this card. Once per round, you can discard 1 <FOOD> from this card to place a person from your supply in that round.
messages.cardFaces.E022_GuestRoom.name: Guest Room
messages.cardFaces.E023_Apiary.description: At the end of each work phase, you can sow exactly 1 crop on 1 <FIELD>.
messages.cardFaces.E023_Apiary.name: Apiary
messages.cardFaces.E024_Ambition.description: Each time you get a __Minor Improvement__ action on an action space, you can build a major improvement instead of playing a minor one.
messages.cardFaces.E024_Ambition.name: Ambition
messages.cardFaces.E025_BumperCrop.description: When you play this card, immediately carry out the field phase on your farmyard only. (This is not a harvest.)
messages.cardFaces.E025_BumperCrop.name: Bumper Crop
messages.cardFaces.E026_Sundial.description: At the end of the work phases of rounds 7 and 9, you can take a __Sow__ action without placing a person.
messages.cardFaces.E026_Sundial.name: Sundial
messages.cardFaces.E027_PiggyBank.description: At the end of each work phase, you can place 1 <FOOD> on this card, irretrievably. At any time, you can discard 6 <FOOD> from this card to build a major improvement at no cost.
messages.cardFaces.E027_PiggyBank.name: Piggy Bank
messages.cardFaces.E028_Bookmark.description: Add 3 to the current round and mark the corresponding round space. At the start of that round, you can play 1 occupation without paying an occupation cost.
messages.cardFaces.E028_Bookmark.name: Bookmark
messages.cardFaces.E029_Heirloom.name: Heirloom
messages.cardFaces.E030_ChildsToy.description: During the feeding phase of each harvest, your newborns require 2 <FOOD> (instead of 1).
messages.cardFaces.E030_ChildsToy.name: Child's Toy
messages.cardFaces.E031_Upholstery.description: Each time you build or play an improvement after this one, you can place 1 <REED> on this card, irretrievably, to get 1 bonus <SCORE>, up to the number of rooms in your house.
messages.cardFaces.E031_Upholstery.name: Upholstery
messages.cardFaces.E032_Nave.description: During scoring, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for each of the 5 columns of your farmyard board containing at least one room.
messages.cardFaces.E032_Nave.name: Nave
messages.cardFaces.E033_BeaverColony.description: From now on, one of your pastures with stable cannot hold animals. Each time you get <REED> from an action space, you get 1 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.cardFaces.E033_BeaverColony.name: Beaver Colony
messages.cardFaces.E034_LandRegister.description: During scoring, if your farm has no unused spaces, you get 2 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.cardFaces.E034_LandRegister.name: Land Register
messages.cardFaces.E035_Misanthropy.description: During scoring, if you have exactly 4/3/2 people, you get 2/3/5 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.cardFaces.E035_Misanthropy.name: Misanthropy
messages.cardFaces.E036_HerbalGarden.description: From now on, at least one of your pastures must contain no animals.
messages.cardFaces.E036_HerbalGarden.name: Herbal Garden
messages.cardFaces.E037_OxSkull.description: During scoring, if you have no <CATTLE>, you get 3 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.cardFaces.E037_OxSkull.name: Ox Skull
messages.cardFaces.E038_RodCollection.description: Each time you use __space:fishing|Fishing__, you can place up to 2 <WOOD> on this card, irretrievably. During scoring, each such <WOOD> is worth 1 bonus <SCORE>, except the 1st, 4th, 7th, and 10th.
messages.cardFaces.E038_RodCollection.name: Rod Collection
messages.cardFaces.E039_Paintbrush.description: Each harvest, you can exchange exactly 1 <CLAY> for your choice of 2 <FOOD> or 1 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.cardFaces.E039_Paintbrush.name: Paintbrush
messages.cardFaces.E040_BeeStatue.description: Pile (from bottom to top) 1 <VEGETABLE>, 1 <STONE>, 1 <GRAIN>, 1 <STONE>, 1 <GRAIN> on this card. Each time you use the __space:day-laborer|Day Laborer__ action space, you get the top good.
messages.cardFaces.E040_BeeStatue.name: Bee Statue
messages.cardFaces.E041_MuddyWaters.description: Alternate placing 1 <FOOD> and 1 <CLAY> on each remaining even-numbered round space, starting with <FOOD>. At the start of these rounds, you get the respective good.
messages.cardFaces.E041_MuddyWaters.name: Muddy Waters
messages.cardFaces.E042_WaterGully.description: Place 1 <CATTLE>, 1 <GRAIN>, and 1 <CATTLE> on the next 3 round spaces (in that order). At the start of these rounds, you get the respective good.
messages.cardFaces.E042_WaterGully.name: Water Gully
messages.cardFaces.E043_BarnCats.description: If you have 1/2/3/4 <STABLE>, place 1 <FOOD> on each of the next 2/3/4/5 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.E043_BarnCats.name: Barn Cats
messages.cardFaces.E044_FodderBeets.description: Place 1 <FOOD> on each remaining odd-numbered round space. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.E044_FodderBeets.name: Fodder Beets
messages.cardFaces.E045_FruitLadder.description: Place 1 <FOOD> on each remaining even-numbered round space. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.E045_FruitLadder.name: Fruit Ladder
messages.cardFaces.E046_WaterlilyPond.description: Place 1 <FOOD> on each of the next 2 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.E046_WaterlilyPond.name: Waterlily Pond
messages.cardFaces.E047_SyrupTap.description: Each time you get at least 1 <WOOD> from an action space, place 1 <FOOD> on the next round space. At the start of that round, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.E047_SyrupTap.name: Syrup Tap
messages.cardFaces.E048_TownHall.description: In the feeding phase of each harvest, if you live in a <CLAY> or stone house, you get 1 or 2 <FOOD>, respectively.
messages.cardFaces.E048_TownHall.name: Town Hall
messages.cardFaces.E049_Twibil.description: Each time after any player (including you) builds at least 1 wood room, you get 1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.E049_Twibil.name: Twibil
messages.cardFaces.E050_WildGreens.description: Each time you sow, you get 1 <FOOD> for every different type of good that you sow.
messages.cardFaces.E050_WildGreens.name: Wild Greens
messages.cardFaces.E051_WhaleOil.description: Each time you use __space:fishing|Fishing__, place 1 <FOOD> from the general supply on this card. Each time before you play an occupation, you get <FOOD> equal to the amount on this card.
messages.cardFaces.E051_WhaleOil.name: Whale Oil
messages.cardFaces.E052_Cubbyhole.description: For each room that you add to your house, place 1 <FOOD> from the general supply on this card. At the start of each feeding phase, you get <FOOD> equal to the amount on this card.
messages.cardFaces.E052_Cubbyhole.name: Cubbyhole
messages.cardFaces.E053_BoarSpear.description: Each time you get at least 1 <PIG> outside of the breeding phase of a harvest, you can immediately turn them into 4 <FOOD> each.
messages.cardFaces.E053_BoarSpear.name: Boar Spear
messages.cardFaces.E054_Contraband.description: Each time you play or build an improvement after this, you can pay 1 additional building resource of a type in the printed cost to get 3 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.E054_Contraband.name: Contraband
messages.cardFaces.E055_StoneWeir.description: Each time you use the __space:fishing|Fishing__ accumulation space, if there are 0/1/2/3 <FOOD> on the space, you get an additional 4/3/2/1 <FOOD> from the general supply.
messages.cardFaces.E055_StoneWeir.name: Stone Weir
messages.cardFaces.E056_RomanPot.description: Place 4 <FOOD> from the general supply on this card. At the start of each work phase, if you are the last player in turn order, move 1 <FOOD> from this card to your supply.
messages.cardFaces.E056_RomanPot.name: Roman Pot
messages.cardFaces.E057_CheeseFondue.description: Each time you bake at least 1 <GRAIN> into bread, you get 1 additional <FOOD> if you have at least 1 <SHEEP> and (another) 1 additional <FOOD> if you have at least 1 <CATTLE>.
messages.cardFaces.E057_CheeseFondue.name: Cheese Fondue
messages.cardFaces.E058_LunchtimeBeer.description: At the start of each harvest, you can choose to skip the <FIELD> and breeding phase of that harvest and get exactly 1 <FOOD> instead.
messages.cardFaces.E058_LunchtimeBeer.name: Lunchtime Beer
messages.cardFaces.E059_CombandCutter.description: Each time you use the __space:day-laborer|Day Laborer__ action space, you get 1 additional <FOOD> for each <SHEEP> on the __space:sheep-market|Sheep Market__ accumulation space, up to a maximum of 4 additional <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.E059_CombandCutter.name: Comb and Cutter
messages.cardFaces.E060_WorkingGloves.description: When you play this card, you get 1 <FOOD>. Each time you pay an occupation cost, you can pay 1 building resource of your choice in place of (up to) 2 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.E060_WorkingGloves.name: Working Gloves
messages.cardFaces.E061_RaisedBed.description: At the start of each harvest, you get 4 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.E061_RaisedBed.name: Raised Bed
messages.cardFaces.E062_SourDough.description: Once per round, if all players have at least 1 person left to place, you can skip placing a person and take a __Bake Bread__ action instead.
messages.cardFaces.E062_SourDough.name: Sour Dough
messages.cardFaces.E063_IronOven.name: Iron Oven
messages.cardFaces.E064_SimpleOven.name: Simple Oven
messages.cardFaces.E065_Almsbag.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <GRAIN> for every 2 completed rounds.
messages.cardFaces.E065_Almsbag.name: Almsbag
messages.cardFaces.E066_BarnShed.description: Each time another player (or, in a solo game, you) uses the __space:forest|Forest__ accumulation space, you get 1 <GRAIN>.
messages.cardFaces.E066_BarnShed.name: Barn Shed
messages.cardFaces.E067_GrainBag.description: Each time you use the __space:grain-seeds|Grain Seeds__ action space, you get 1 additional <GRAIN> for each <BAKE>-improvement you have.
messages.cardFaces.E067_GrainBag.name: Grain Bag
messages.cardFaces.E068_CherryOrchard.description: This card is a <FIELD> on which you can only sow and harvest <WOOD> as you would <GRAIN>. Each time you harvest the last <WOOD> from this card, you also receive 1 <VEGETABLE>.
messages.cardFaces.E068_CherryOrchard.name: Cherry Orchard
messages.cardFaces.E069_MelonPatch.description: This card is a <FIELD> that can only grow <VEGETABLE>. Each time you harvest the last <VEGETABLE> from this card, you can plow 1 <FIELD>.
